card.name: Inside journal reference citations
card.fires_on: Pieces of bibliographic citations in reference lists, just before page, volume or ISBN numbers. Examples are the space after a journal abbreviation, 'pp', a colon after the volume, or a digit inside a number.

modes.label: Before page or volume numbers
modes.description: Spaces, 'pp' or colons right before the volume or page numbers in a journal citation.

modes.label: Digits inside citation numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a volume number or ISBN in a reference.

modes.label: Agency names in references
modes.description: A word in a publisher or agency name inside a citation.
modes.example: U.S. Department of<< Health>> and Human Services

card.writes: No clear link; the promoted tokens are mixed names and Chinese political phrases, which have little to do with citations.
card.plain: It fires inside the small details of a reference list entry, such as page and volume numbers.
